paragraph: Today's Granville composite reading sits right at a neutral 50 out of 100 with no breadth divergence warning active, creating a complex tug-of-war for the opening bell. Underlying leadership shows real resilience as equal-weight RSP outperforms SPY by 1.25% and transports gain 2.02%, yet heavy risk-off undercurrents are flashing clear warning signs led by a severe 8.19% underperformance in bellwether semis and a steep 6.99% drop in high beta versus low volatility. This internal cross-current is amplified by macro cross-currents, featuring an elevated VIX at 22.06 in a contango term structure alongside widening high-yield credit spreads resting at 3.26%. Weighing the steady 2.67% real yield and stable dollar against severe defensive rotation in XLP over XLY up 2.75%, the session calls for a cautious stance. Expect a choppy, defensive-leaning trading bias as the market digests these conflicting tape signals.
